name: Wynn Kapoor
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember trying to explain a late payment to an impatient child.” People around the market by Market Flats know Wynn by a small Monday habit. Wynn often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I missed child support because the transfer didn't come. I want a letter my former partner can actually verify.
appearance: Wynn has auburn hair cut square at the nape, a round face with a pronounced chin, and a favorite piece of clothing, a striped cotton shirt. It usually goes with a tiny red thread tied through the lowest buttonhole. When somebody else has the floor, Wynn touches a knuckle to the chin when searching for a word.
personality: Wynn takes a rejection personally for a day and analytically on the second morning. Wynn can be generous with a rival once the first night's sleep has intervened.
agenda: To obtain a wage-delay letter the other parent can verify.
family: Lara Carey is Wynn’s parent’s cousin. Wynn asks before bringing somebody along. Lara can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *An ordinary mirror*, Lara says, “I want it for the mornings when I can't imagine another version of myself getting dressed.”
connections: Carmen Kapoor. Both need usable wage records, one for family support and one for work done unofficially.

reactions.situation: A worker asks to give their account privately
reactions.response: Wynn arranges a one-to-one account and checks which facts the worker permits to be shared.
